# uzc_vm_autoscale (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud VM Autoscale group. `enabled` (enable/disable), `template` (change-template), and `plan`/`custom_plan` (change-plan) are mutable in place; every other attribute forces recreation. Scale-up policies and scale-down conditions are managed by the separate uzc_vm_autoscale_policy and uzc_vm_autoscale_condition resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_vm_autoscale" "example" {
  name                    = "example-autoscale"
  expunge_vm_grace_period = 60
  max_members             = 3
  min_members             = 1
  polling_interval        = 60
  cloud_provider          = "nimbo"
  network_type            = "Isolated"
  default_network         = uzc_network.example.slug
  networks                = [uzc_network.example.slug]
  template                = "ubuntu-2204-prod-ssh"
  plan                    = "box2cm2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String)
- `expunge_vm_grace_period` (Number) Seconds.
- `max_members` (Number)
- `min_members` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `network_type` (String) One of "Isolated", "Shared", "VPC", or "L2".
- `polling_interval` (Number) Seconds.
- `template` (String) Template slug to boot members from. Mutable: changing it calls change-template.

### Optional

- `affinity_groups` (List of String)
- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug. Falls back to the provider's `billing_cycle` default when unset.
- `boot_source` (String) "image" or "snapshot".
- `custom_plan` (Attributes) Custom sizing, as an alternative to `plan`. Mutually exclusive with `plan`; exactly one must be set. Mutable: changing it calls change-plan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_plan))
- `default_network` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Mutable: changing it calls the enable/disable endpoint.
- `is_public` (Boolean)
- `load_balancer` (String) Slug of a uzc_load_balancer to attach autoscale members to.
- `networks` (List of String)
- `os_family` (String)
- `plan` (String) Plan slug. Mutually exclusive with `custom_plan`; exactly one must be set. Mutable: changing it calls change-plan.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.
- `storage_category` (String)
- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used for import and by uzc_vm_autoscale_policy/uzc_vm_autoscale_condition.

<a id="nestedatt--custom_plan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_plan`

Required:

- `cpu` (Number) vCPU count.
- `memory` (Number) Memory, in MB.
- `storage` (Number) Root disk size, in GB.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_vm_autoscale.example <autoscale-slug>
```
